## Chapter Seventeen

Rabbiting



Three hours later a black box van floated down from the sky landing near them in the field. As it touched down the side door opened and Chang and Victoria, both in Tactical suits leaped from the door, quickly finding Lucas waving them on and they approached rapidly. The three soldiers carried there fallen comrade gently into the box van. Once he had been strapped in Chu entered the driver’s seat and quickly and expertly lifted the van, climbing towards the sparse traffic of the skyway. Victoria and Lucas spent a few minutes making Rolle comfortable. He had awoken only once when they moved him. “Is he going to be alright?” Lucas asked, looking worriedly at his friend. Victoria put a hand on his arm and squeezed. “Aunt Sally will get him the best care; don’t worry he will be up and about in no time” she said locking a serious but reassuring gaze with him.



“By the way, I need to thank you for the little balls that disrupt sensors, without those we would be dead” Lucas said earnestly. “Thank you” came a female voice from the font and Lucas turned to see a little pixie of a woman with bright red short hair that spiked, lending to the pixie features on her face. A large earnest smile spread across her face. Victoria Nudged Lucas “Easy boy, this is Emma, my fiancé” she said, the pride and love evident in her voice. “That’s right, I’m the hardware to my baby’s software” she finished for the couple. “It’s a pleasure to meet you, Rolle and I both owe you our lives for that little toy you created” Lucas said reciprocating the infectious grin from the little woman.

The woman’s smile fell and her eyes became distant “Your welcome, but im sorry you weren’t able to safe Ruth or Bobbie back there, they were good people and didn’t deserve what the Vipers did to them” she said. Lucas nodded, there was a special place in hell for those people and he was itching to help them get there.

They flew for a few hours, returning to the city , landing just outside the poverty bloc an unmarked ambulance met them, quickly taking charge of Rolle Victoria put her hand on Lucas’s arm again restraining him from getting in the way “It’s okay, I know these guys Sally sent them” she said. Reluctantly Lucas let them take his friend. “Where is he going?” he asked looking between the departing ambulance and her. “He will meet us at Babel” she answered as if the name would hold some significance for him. “What?” he asked confused. “She just shook her head. “Sally can explain”. With that they entered the bloc with little fanfare, there clothes changed, and the tactical gear carried in Gym bags, the benefit of both the bags and the guards, they relied too heavy on sensors that the simple looking gym bags were designed by Emma to fool.

They went straight the club to find the Kimono clad Sally arguing with Job. The two looked angry and about to come to blows when the group entered into the main and barren dancefloor. The main floor now littered with packed boxes and other items too large to fit into simple cardboard containers.

“What’s going on” Lucas whispered, and this time Chow answered, he had not spoken a word the entire trip, so Lucas was surprised when he spoke and to Lucas’s memory one of the very few times, he had heard the Japanese man’s voice. “We are prepping to move, none of our hideouts are safe, this is part of the scorched earth protocols” he said simply and then walked directly over to Sally, Eyeing Job suspiciously he hovered just close enough to be motioned over quickly but not close enough to eavesdrop.

As the group approached the two men stepped away, Job heading towards the door without a word, Lucas looked after his friend and roommate, he had never seen the man look so upset, or walk away without even acknowledging his friend.

“What was that about?” Lucas asked Sally as he stood there flushed and irritated the other man dramatically waved his hand “It’s nothing” he said and then finished the glass of high-octane liquid in front of him.

Sally paused , looking Lucas over “Its good your okay kid, without you Rolle would have been dead, thank you” he said gently and wrapped the much smaller man into a bear hug. “Im glad we got out” Lucas responded. Sally released him and nodded at the boxes and other valuables throughout the main room “We are moving, once we couldn’t get ahold you , we put the emergency out over the wire, using the numbers station everyone is gathering at Babel” he said Lucas nodding hearing that word again, “What is babel?” he asked looking between he small group.

Sally smiled “It’s our emergency location, we have never used it, but everyone who comes in knows about it, eventually you would have been given the location as well. Its off the grid and all of our people will gather there, once there we will try to get everyone out, we don’t know who has been compromised so everyone needs to get out of the country, the network is disbanding for now” he said, the last part causing the older man to grimace.

Lucas nodded “How the hell are we supposed to get all this” he started waving his arms around the large dance floor “out of the bloc without being noticed. Sally smiled “We planned for everything” he simply said.

A moment later the small group stood over a large open portal in the floor, it had been hidden by the oven, the portal let to a dimly lit tunnel. “When we moved into the building and bought it the first thing, we did was to ensure we have an emergency exit should we need it.” Sally said staring down at the tunnel with pride.

With a clap of his hands he stood, his pink kimono flapping around the Bahama shorts and hairy chest underneath. “Okay, Lucas you go with Emma and Victoria, we need to get out setup, your security, Chow will gather the right people and start moving items through the tunnel, we are out of here before dusk” he finished. Everyone nodded going their own way. Lucas followed the two women deep into the club to a back room filled floor to ceiling with electronics and other detritus, two work stations stood as a temple to order in an otherwise chaotic world surrounding them. Victoria took one seat and Emma the other.

Chow came in and without a word dropped the gym bags they had come in with. Victoria and Emma began pawing through the contents, organizing it on a table next to the desk once they had removed the junk piled on the table and unceremoniously dumped on to the floor.

“So, how did you two end up here with Sally?” Lucas asked conversationally. He had always wondered about Victoria’s story.

He noticed Emma wince and share a meaningful look with her fiancé. Victoria gave a small nod and Emma sat on the edge of the desk. “As you know, those of us who have alternative sexual preferences are seen as criminals, pariahs in this wonderful new country” she said the last line coming out dripping with Sarcasm. Lucas nodded urging the young woman to continue. “About three years ago, we were out in the park in our home town, making out, we thought we were alone until two police officers happened upon us. “They could have arrested us, we would have gone to jail but instead the two officers decided to teach us a lesson” She began and Lucas could see the tears in both the woman’s eyes, sharing a look Victoria urged her fiancé to continue. She gently took Emma’s hand offering as much comfort and support but urging her to continue. “They handcuffed me to a tree and made me watch as they took turns raping Victoria” Lucas stopped breathing, anger welling up as he thought of the two powerless girls and the two animals who had the audacity to call themselves protectors of society. “The whole time, they kept saying they were doing her a favor, because it was obvious she had never had a real man and that they were going to come back and teach me the same lesson, the whole time laughing and making comments” she whispered, finishing the story.

Victoria slipped her arms around Emma and gave her a long kiss pushing her forehead against Emma’s in a moment of gentle intimacy and love that shamed Lucas into lowering his eyes. “I’m so sorry” he whispered, his voice thick with anger and sorrow. He had never felt embarrassed to be a man until that moment and wished he could find the two officers and teach them a lesson about respecting others.

“We went home and told her parents, her father told her she had asked for it, flaunting her deviant choices and that we should go thank the officers for not arresting us” Emma finished spitting the last part. “We ran away the same night, we traveled for a bit until Sally caught us running an illegal credit scam and recruited us” Victoria finished as Emma wiped her eyes. “He saved us” Emma nodded at the comment. “IM so sorry” Lucas said, the statement completely underwhelming to how he actually felt but no words could express the depth of emotions running through his body like an electric current.

Kissing Emma one last time Victoria stood “That was the past, we all have our stories” she said staring at Lucas pointedly. “But we are here now, and we will make a difference for the people who live under the oppression of this corporate government.” She finished, going back to the gym bag and continuing to lay out the contents. It was obvious that Victoria was done talking about it and with a nod Lucas shifted gears, not wanting to be the cause of her reliving the pain of the experience.

Victoria and Emma both concentrating on going over the gear both women wincing and making noises as they poured over the suits and weapons. “What?” Lucas finally asked defensively. “Next time just take off the suits and put them in a blender” Victoria said annoyed. Lucas shook his head “Sorry, next time we will ask the soldiers to go easy on the suits” he finished smiling at the two of them. Emma returned an apologetic grin “She gets testy about the tech, why don’t you go down and see Sally, we will finish up and get this fixed” Emma finished shooing Lucas out of the room.

Entering the main dance hall he could see the group of people Chow herded over had already put quite a dent in the boxes and other items in the short amount of time he had been away. Looking over to the bar he found Sally still holding up the end, a new drink In front of him and from the looks, deep in thought. “Hey” Lucas called coming over to the bar. Sally looked up, clearing his head, with a smile he produced a second glass, half filling it and sliding it over to Lucas as he reached the bar. “hey kiddo, how’s tricks” he said, but something was bothering the older man, the smile looked false and the worry lines on his face looked new. Lucas quietly studied his friend while taking a sip of the bitter alcohol. With a wince he put the glass on the table and absently rolled it with his hands. “What’s wrong Sally?” he asked gently. Looking worriedly at the older man. Sally deflated, leaning further on the bar. With a sigh he looked up at Lucas. “I’m worried, something isn’t right, and it feels like we are lambs being led to the slaughter. Never in our history have we been so thoroughly compromised and its bothering me, I don’t believe Dyson betrayed us, despite how it looks” he said at a whisper, Lucas glanced around the room to ensure they were alone. “I don’t think so either, why don’t you?” he asked curiously and relieved he wasn’t the only one.

Sally took another sip and gathered his thoughts “First, the safehouse, the one where Dyson had his starring role, he didn’t know about that, that house wasn’t put together until the old one had burned down, and we needed a replacement. So how did he know about it without reaching out to the network?” Sally began and Lucas nodded, he did not know that, how had he, he did remember Dyson receiving messages on the inside but most of those had come from Sally through an intermediary. “Second , Dyson wasn’t stupid, you know the training, he would spot surveillance camera’s without thinking about it, he taught all of us, he wouldn’t be careless to let himself be caught on film.” Sally shook his head “Lots of little things and big things don’t add up, and frankly I’m scared, I feel like I am playing chess and the rules keep changing” he slapped the old wooden bar with his meaty palm in frustration.

Lucas nodded “What was going on with Job this morning, you guys looked like you were about to come to blows” he asked, and Sally shook his head. “We were talking about you, he was pushing to try and find out what Dyson had wanted with you, he put a lot of time and energy into your training and giving you a position in the underground, bypassing all of our checks and inserting you directly into the center of the operation” Sally said frankly. Lucas nodded understanding Job’s frustration.

“I want to know too, I know what he told me, he owed my dad, but he has gone above and beyond and I don’t know why, Sally, he seems like there is more here, and I know Dyson played his cards close to his vest, but I don’t want to come to find out that I am part of some master plan to dismantle this operation, I believe in it, I am proud to be a part of it despite of how I got here” he said thinking about his father in that small glass box as the thick fog slowly killed him. Sally shook his head, “Now is not the time to discuss you and why you are here, we need to get this place cleaned out and get moved.” He said. Lucas was about to ask what he meant, thinking that Sally might know more than he was letting on as to Lucas’s own mysterious role there.

Before he could Sally looked at him pointedly “Do you know where Job went, after he stormed off, I figure he would blow off steam and then return, but I have not seen him or heard from him” Sally asked. Lucas shook his head. “I need to grab a few small things from the shop, I will check when I am there.” He said Sally nodded and Lucas headed for the stairs.

The air outside was cold and the street was still not many people out as if they were laying low, sensing a coming danger as people in some neighborhoods are sometimes able to, a survival instinct bred into those who live in areas where danger can be ever present. It added to Lucas’s own unease. He pulled up the collar on the black coat and walked faster towards the shop.

Reaching the door to the old brick building he could see the closed sign in the door and the lights were off. Using his code, he entered and made his way to the stairs in the back. It looked as if the shop had not been open for a few days, but he didn’t think anything of it since they were bailing.

Heading up stairs he found the apartment empty no sign of Job. Lucas packed his things, leaving a note for Job should he return he went downstairs and headed back to the club. Two hours had passed since he had left Sally and the sun was beginning to set, coldness descending upon the bloc. As he approached the building, he stopped cold. Familiar looking black SUV type vehicles were parked around the entrance. Two guards in tactical gear stood outside looking around warily. Lucas’s blood went cold, this was not happening, he couldn’t lose his friends, he wouldn’t lose them. He dropped his bag, reaching up under the jacket and feeling the knife harness, grabbing two blades he began to make his way unsteadily towards the two guards, muttering to himself and swaying randomly.

He approached as if randomly for every step forward he took two to the side. The men noticed him instantly, and tensed, but not as if a threat approached, more like an annoyance he observed. Lucas never looked directly at them, raising his voice he continued to rant “bitch told me to go , I wadnt gonna go, she was gonna go, mother fucker thing sheesh in charge, she gonna find out im da man” he said shaking his head, taking two more steps towards the two guards, but not in a direct or threatening manner.

The guard on the left let out an aggravated sigh and approached. “Hey buddy, get the fuck out of here, this is a crime zone” he said and extended the butt of his gun to push Lucas away from the stairwell. Lucas felt the butt of the shotgun touch his chest and his hand snaked out lightning fast, he pulled hard and the guard came off balance, falling towards him. It looked to the guard behind him whos’ view of Lucas was blocked by the first guard. As if his friend had lost his balance and he laughed just as Lucas’s other hand snaked out and his Blade found the soft padding in between the Kevlar that protected him. He heard the quick inhale of breath and the phlegmy exhale as the blade found his lung.

Lucas twisted the shotgun out of the guard’s hand as he fell to his knees. The other guard quickly realized this crazy homeless man wasn’t so crazy and in fact was a threat, he began to raise his own gun as Lucas threw the shotgun at him. Reflexively the guard raised his hand and turned away, revealing his side and the unprotected area of his vest. He snapped his hand and sent the blade flying into his side the three-inch blade sinking into the area just under his arm all the way to the hilt. The pain made his gun slip and fall to the ground. Going into shock the guard ignored the threat to pick up the weapon and Lucas Launched himself at him, Landing a series of Blows across his neck and across his ribs.

He expertly grabbed another blade from the harness, bringing it across the guard’s neck and severing the big artery. Blood shot out and covered the arm of his coat. The guard quickly grabbed at his neck trying to stem the hot pumping liquid as it left his body. But he was too late and as Lucas stood there in a fighter’s stance, the guard bled out before his eyes.

Turning back to the second guard, he walked over and speared the bloody blade into the back of his neck, severing the spinal cord. There was no feeling watching these men die, there was no remorse, they had come to kill his friends and he would not allow it.

His nostrils flaring with anger and the scent of fresh blood he took three stairs at a time jumping down to the base of the landing, he threw open the door to the long empty hall. Lucas broke out into a run, his mind running through every possible scenario as to what he would find upon reaching the club. Entering the old catwalk above the dancefloor he looked over to see that the boxes and items had been removed, the place was empty except for a group around the bar.



Keeping as quiet as possible Lucas approached from above. Rolling his feet as he walked, he willed the old metal not to creak as he as gently as possible put his weight on it. He made it to the stairs and descended, watching the group at the bar. Standing in the middle was Sally with his grey wig askew and the pink kimono open to show those ugly Bahama shorts. He was talking to the guards with his hands raised as two of them had pistols trained on the old man. A flash of anger ignited in Lucas as he reached the floor.



He quietly pulled two more blades out from the harness and doing the math knew he only had two left, there were six guards, he couldn’t throw enough or with the speed that would allow him to overtake all the guards before someone got a shot off.



Moving forwards towards them he tried to think of a way to even the odds, anything that would help him to end Sally’s captivity with neither of them dying, he now wondered where everyone else was, and were they alive.



He was twenty feet from the group when one of the guards raised the pistol to Sally’s head, Lucas knew he was out of time and without thinking threw the knife and shouted “Hey” getting the groups attention. He watched in slow motion as the group turned, guns training on him, with only one knife in his hand he knew, he was dead.



Then just on the outside of his focus, something glinted on Sally’s wrists and faster then Lucas would have believed possible the man’s hands came down from the surrender position Jabbing and slashing with amazing speed. Before Lucas could comprehend what, he was seeing the six guards dropped to the floor, blood beginning to pool around them as if they were wading in red pool. Sally stepped over them towards Lucas and with a flick of his wrists, Lucas watched as two five-inch blades ascended back into the sleeves of the kimono. “How?” Lucas asked, still processing the event in his head. Sally just smiled giving the young man a hug “Where do you think Dyson learned to fight, before I was a fabulous club owner, I was a lead presidential guard for the board, well until someone found out about my propensity for dressing like this” he said flourishing his arms and doing a quick spin. Lucas shook it off “I’m just glad your okay” he said gratefully.



The smile diminishing on his face he urgently asked “Where is everyone?” the fear for his friends driving out the question with force. Sally shook his head and smiled weakly. “They are fine, they got out and are on their way to babel, I was waiting on you, when this group got the drop on me” he said pointing back at the bodies and blood.

Lucas nodded, pushing the blade back into the harness. “Two more outside, so it won’t be long before drones and more guards are surrounding this place” he said and then urging Sally back towards the kitchen “we have to go now” he said.



Sally nodded and they both hurried back into the kitchen, they opened the hatch on the tunnel and then Sally paused as he pushed on a piece of metal backwall that had been behind the stove and a small panel popped open, he hit a few buttons and then nodded to Lucas “We need to leave and now” .



The two of them quickly descended the ladder closing the heavy hatch behind them and raced along the narrow man-made dirt tunnel. As they reached the other end Lucas saw another ladder leading up and thought randomly what a pain it must have been to move all those boxes out this way. Just as he reached the ladder there was a loud muffled whoomph and the entire tunnel shook, sending shafts of sand and silt from the ceiling onto there heads. Lucas didn’t need any prodding and took the rungs two at a time, reaching an identical escape hatch, he flung it open and crawled out, he helped Sally up and then surveyed where they were. He could see they had come up outside the wall to the poverty bloc and now a large column of smoke filled the air where he assumed the club had been moments before. “Covering our tracks?” Lucas asked with a half-smile.



Sally shook his head. “Absolutely, it will take them a while to figure out we weren’t in the building when it went up, and by the time they do. We will be long gone.



Sally motioned Lucas to follow and approached a very small red sportscar, the kind any woman in the upscale neighborhoods might bop around town in for a day of shopping and Lucas whistled, this was definitely not a utility van. Sally smiled. “I am glad you approve; this is my baby, her name is red” he said running his hand gently along the sleek hood. They climbed in , Sally wedging his large frame behind the wheel. As the car rose out of the garage and towards the sky, Lucas took the time to look down and see the crater that had once been Sally’s club, his home. “Im sorry about the club” Lucas said turning to his friend. He could see the sadness on his face as he smiled. “It can be replaced” he stated almost as much to himself as to Lucas. As they rose towards the skyway they merged into the afternoon city traffic and headed north. “Sally, I have to ask, how is it they don’t trace the cars we get away in to our destinations, I mean that would be child’s play?” Lucas queried his friend who smiled. Sally shook his head “Because technology makes them lazy kiddo, every car has a transponder, which gets pinged randomly on the highway, so they can track any vehicle along the skyway to where they exit, making it child’s play to find any vehicle, unless someone amazingly talented tech goddess, like Emma programmed the transponder to change vehicles information after every ping. Since they don’t use cameras to get a visual of the vehicle, it appears to have disappeared. There is also a broadcasting pulse similar to that little device you like to carry that shuts down camera’s as we approach and then turns them on again. Now anyone who was smart could probably figure out where we went if they could track those pulses, but since the devices are designed and regulated for use by highly placed government officials, they don’t log the shutdown” he finished, the smile now beaming. “Isn’t technology grand. “ He finished rocketing above the cracked and broken remains of Maryland I-270 below.
